allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 16, 2025, titled " Z  Board approves issue of fully convertible warrants to Promoter Group entities on a preferential basis, to enhance the Company s financial foundation & implement strategic growth plan in the realm of Content & Technology".
